text: Northwind Auto Finance (SYNTHETIC) policy NW-AUTO-STD version 2026.1, clause 1.1 Scope: This policy governs indicative eligibility for fixed-rate loans on new private passenger vehicles in India, denominated in INR. It is a synthetic document created for a capstone demonstration and is not an offer of credit.

Northwind Auto Finance (SYNTHETIC) policy NW-AUTO-STD version 2026.1, clause 1.2 Purpose: The policy sets out who may borrow, how much may be lent, on what terms, and which vehicles may be financed. Every automated decision must cite the clause it relies on. Where this policy is silent, no automated rejection may be made on that ground.

Northwind Auto Finance (SYNTHETIC) policy NW-AUTO-STD version 2026.1, clause 2.1 Credit score: Applicants must have a credit score of at least 650 from an accepted bureau. Accepted bureaus are CIBIL and EXPERIAN.

Northwind Auto Finance (SYNTHETIC) policy NW-AUTO-STD version 2026.1, clause 2.2 Minimum income: Qualifying monthly income must be at least INR 25,000. Annual income is converted to a monthly figure by dividing by 12.

Northwind Auto Finance (SYNTHETIC) policy NW-AUTO-STD version 2026.1, clause 2.3 Employment: Eligible employment categories are salaried and self-employed. Salaried applicants require at least 6 months of continuous employment. Self-employed applicants require at least 24 months in business.
Northwind Auto Finance (SYNTHETIC) policy NW-AUTO-STD version 2026.1, clause 2.4 Active loans: Applicants may have at most 3 active loans of any type at the time of application.

Northwind Auto Finance (SYNTHETIC) policy NW-AUTO-STD version 2026.1, clause 2.5 Applicant-specific income evidence: For self-employed applicants, qualifying income is the average monthly income shown in the last two income-tax returns. For salaried applicants, qualifying income is the net monthly salary credited to the bank account over the last three months. Rental and investment income may be included only if it has been received for at least 12 months.

Northwind Auto Finance (SYNTHETIC) policy NW-AUTO-STD version 2026.1, clause 3.1 Debt-service limit: Total monthly debt obligations, including the proposed EMI, must not exceed 50% of qualifying monthly income. The maximum loan is the principal that the remaining monthly capacity can repay over the chosen tenure.

Northwind Auto Finance (SYNTHETIC) policy NW-AUTO-STD version 2026.1, clause 3.2 Interest rates: Interest is charged at a fixed nominal annual rate compounded monthly, determined by credit score: 750 to 900 at 8.75%; 700 to 749 at 9.75%; 650 to 699 at 11.25%.
Northwind Auto Finance (SYNTHETIC) policy NW-AUTO-STD version 2026.1, clause 3.3 Tenure: Loan tenure must be between 12 and 84 monthly instalments.
Northwind Auto Finance (SYNTHETIC) policy NW-AUTO-STD version 2026.1, clause 3.4 Loan amount: The loan principal must be between INR 1,00,000 and INR 50,00,000.

Northwind Auto Finance (SYNTHETIC) policy NW-AUTO-STD version 2026.1, clause 3.5 Loan-to-value: The loan may not exceed 85% of the vehicle on-road price, being the ex-showroom price plus registration, insurance and other mandatory charges.

Northwind Auto Finance (SYNTHETIC) policy NW-AUTO-STD version 2026.1, clause 3.7 Credit risk assessment: Applications that satisfy sections 2 and 3 are scored by the lender's validated credit-risk model (vla-eligibility). An application is approved only if the model's estimated approval probability is at least 0.83; otherwise it is declined on credit-risk grounds and the applicant may request a manual review under section 5.

Northwind Auto Finance (SYNTHETIC) policy NW-AUTO-STD version 2026.1, clause 3.6 Processing fee: A processing fee of 1% of the loan principal, subject to a minimum of INR 2,500 and a maximum of INR 15,000, is payable upfront and is not financed.

Northwind Auto Finance (SYNTHETIC) policy NW-AUTO-STD version 2026.1, clause 4.1 Vehicle restrictions: Commercial vehicles are excluded. Vehicle prices older than 120 days must be re-verified before affordability is confirmed.

Northwind Auto Finance (SYNTHETIC) policy NW-AUTO-STD version 2026.1, clause 4.2 Rounding: EMIs are rounded half-up to the nearest 0.01 rupee. The eligible principal is rounded down to the nearest INR 1,000.

Northwind Auto Finance (SYNTHETIC) policy NW-AUTO-STD version 2026.1, clause 5.1 Manual review: An applicant declined on credit-risk grounds under clause 3.7 may request a manual review by a credit officer. Manual review cannot override sections 2, 3.1, 3.3, 3.4 or 3.5.

Northwind Auto Finance (SYNTHETIC) policy NW-AUTO-STD version 2026.1, clause 5.2 Co-applicants: A spouse or parent may join as co-applicant. Co-applicant income is added to qualifying income only after manual review and is never applied by the automated assessment.

Northwind Auto Finance (SYNTHETIC) policy NW-AUTO-STD version 2026.1, clause 5.3 First-time borrowers: Applicants with no credit history cannot be assessed automatically and are referred to a credit officer.

Northwind Auto Finance (SYNTHETIC) policy NW-AUTO-STD version 2026.1, clause 6.2 Additional documents for salaried applicants: salary slips for the last three months and the latest Form 16: Additional documents for self-employed applicants: income-tax returns for the last two years and proof of business continuity.

text: Southbay Motor Credit (SYNTHETIC) policy SB-AUTO-PRIME version 2026.1, clause A1 Scope: Synthetic prime lending policy for new private passenger vehicles in India, denominated in INR. For capstone demonstration only.
Southbay Motor Credit (SYNTHETIC) policy SB-AUTO-PRIME version 2026.1, clause B1 Credit score: A CIBIL credit score of at least 700 is required. Other bureaus are not accepted.
Southbay Motor Credit (SYNTHETIC) policy SB-AUTO-PRIME version 2026.1, clause B2 Income: Qualifying monthly income must be at least INR 40,000.

Southbay Motor Credit (SYNTHETIC) policy SB-AUTO-PRIME version 2026.1, clause B3 Employment: Salaried applicants need 12 months of continuous employment; self-employed applicants need 36 months in business. Other categories are ineligible.
Southbay Motor Credit (SYNTHETIC) policy SB-AUTO-PRIME version 2026.1, clause B4 Active loans: No more than 2 active loans are permitted at the time of application.

Southbay Motor Credit (SYNTHETIC) policy SB-AUTO-PRIME version 2026.1, clause C1 Debt-service limit: All monthly debt obligations including the new EMI must not exceed 40% of qualifying monthly income.
Southbay Motor Credit (SYNTHETIC) policy SB-AUTO-PRIME version 2026.1, clause C2 Rates: Fixed nominal annual rate compounded monthly: score 750 to 900 at 9.25%; score 700 to 749 at 10.5%.
Southbay Motor Credit (SYNTHETIC) policy SB-AUTO-PRIME version 2026.1, clause C3 Tenure: Tenure must be between 12 and 60 months.
Southbay Motor Credit (SYNTHETIC) policy SB-AUTO-PRIME version 2026.1, clause C4 Loan amount: Principal must be between INR 2,00,000 and INR 30,00,000.
Southbay Motor Credit (SYNTHETIC) policy SB-AUTO-PRIME version 2026.1, clause C5 Loan-to-value: Maximum loan-to-value is 80% of the on-road price.

Southbay Motor Credit (SYNTHETIC) policy SB-AUTO-PRIME version 2026.1, clause C7 Credit risk: Applications meeting parts B and C are approved only if the validated credit-risk model (vla-eligibility) estimates an approval probability of at least 0.88.
Southbay Motor Credit (SYNTHETIC) policy SB-AUTO-PRIME version 2026.1, clause C6 Fees: Processing fee is 1.5% of principal, minimum INR 5,000, maximum INR 25,000, payable upfront.
Southbay Motor Credit (SYNTHETIC) policy SB-AUTO-PRIME version 2026.1, clause D1 Vehicles: Commercial vehicles are excluded. Prices older than 90 days must be re-verified.
Southbay Motor Credit (SYNTHETIC) policy SB-AUTO-PRIME version 2026.1, clause D2 Rounding: EMI rounded half-up to 0.01; principal rounded down to INR 1,000.

Southbay Motor Credit (SYNTHETIC) policy SB-AUTO-PRIME version 2026.1, clause E1 Exceptions: Exceptions to parts B and C are not permitted for the prime product. Declined applicants may be offered the standard product of another lender.

Southbay Motor Credit (SYNTHETIC) policy SB-AUTO-PRIME version 2026.1, clause E2 Documentation: Identity and address proof, six months of bank statements, salary slips or two years of tax returns, and the dealer proforma invoice.
